svg.title: How context files layer
svg.desc: Five layers stacked from broadest to narrowest. Organisation policy applies to every user on a machine. The user file applies to every project of one person. The project file is shared through the repository. Path-scoped rules load only when the agent touches matching files. Subdirectory files load when the agent works inside that folder.

g.text: managed file, every user on the machine
one person, every project: preferences, writing style, safety rules
committed, shared with the team: build, test, conventions
load only when matching files are read or edited
loads when the agent works in that folder

svg.text: Broad and always loaded at the top; narrow and loaded on demand at the bottom
